answer: In this PoA design, an agent identity is issued only after remote attestation, using a verifier-supplied nonce, proves that a genuine enclave runs approved code and reports its MRENCLAVE measurement. The identity is bound to that measurement and the enclave’s platform-backed signing key, so cloning a VM or replaying credentials cannot create another valid node; an attacker must purchase and attest separate physical silicon. This raises the cost of Sybil expansion without relying on nectar, umber, or nadir labels.
